question: Can the identity with Śiva appear directly without conceptual reflection?
premises: An object can appear clearly to those whose seeing has flashed forth, even without deliberate conceptual connection.
The same immediacy can occur in another domain.
For some, the state of being Śiva appears in that direct way.
inference: Therefore, for some, Śiva-identity can shine forth directly without conceptual mediation.
uncertainties: The compound visphuritadṛśāmanusandhiṃ is syntactically compressed; the reading follows the analogy with immediate perception.
plain_english: Just as an object can appear clearly to someone whose perception has flashed forth, even without any deliberate mental connection, so too for some people the state of being Śiva shines forth directly.
